run_f_gold: run f_gold to calculate total temple offerings from a list of temple heights
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the provided parameter sets in the main block
review_f_gold: review f_gold which counts consecutive ascending temple heights left and right of each temple
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold algorithm that computes max(left, right) + 1 offerings per temple
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to optimize the O(n^2) nested loop approach for temple offering calculation
